name: ciloop
description: Drive failing GitHub Actions CI back to green by reading logs, reproducing locally, fixing, pushing once, and re-watching.

interface.shortDescription: Drive failing CI back to green
interface.longDescription: ciloop pulls the real failure from GitHub Actions logs, maps it to a local command, fixes confident failures, pushes once, and re-watches the new run. It hands back flaky, infra, secret, and ambiguous failures instead of guessing.
